mapper.select: SELECT id, sales_order_id, activity_id, activity_version, activity_snapshot, coupon_instance_id, coupon_snapshot, base_amount, discount_amount, allocations::text AS allocations, rounding_target_item_id, created_at, created_by, version FROM order_discount WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_discount (sales_order_id, activity_id, activity_version, activity_snapshot, coupon_instance_id, coupon_snapshot, base_amount, discount_amount, allocations, rounding_target_item_id, created_at, created_by, version) VALUES (#{row.salesOrderId}, #{row.activityId}, #{row.activityVersion}, #{row.activitySnapshot,typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.common.json.JsonbObjectMapTypeHandler}, #{row.couponInstanceId}, #{row.couponSnapshot,typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.common.json.JsonbObjectMapTypeHandler}, #{row.baseAmount}, #{row.discountAmount}, #{row.allocations}::jsonb, #{row.roundingTargetItemId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{row.createdBy}, 0)
